caption: Our first free AI generation: four images from one prompt, and the card text SPRING SALE 20% OFF came out right on all four.
The second free generation with the same prompt: again four images with the card text spelled right.
A generated image opened full size: it carries a Shutterstock AI-Generated Image watermark until it is licensed.
Download as JPEG asked for a GenAI subscription: EUR 9 a month billed yearly at EUR 108, or EUR 19 a month with no contract, with 100 generation credits a month.
A third generation opened the plan screen instead: GenAI at EUR 9 or Unlimited Plus at EUR 49 a month, both billed yearly.
A stock photo page on 22 Nov 2026: Unlimited Images at EUR 29 a month or image packs, from EUR 18 for one image to EUR 169 for 25.
